Stories discussed in this episode:

  • AT&T appears to have no plans to support Apple's new iPhone Handoff feature
  • Disney+ and Hulu have raised their prices — here's what they cost now
  • Apple says it will release a software update next week to fix an iPhone 18 Pro reboot bug
  • Some users hit an iPhone 18 Pro Face ID bug that crashes and reboots the system
  • An iOS 27.0.1 update is coming soon for iPhone
